stages.title: Project setup and first deploy
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-0-setup.md: four tasks, a review per task, a final whole-branch review on Opus and one fix wave. Decisions by Arthur during the stage: events.user_id nullable (a Lead or Purchase whose click lost its user), events.event_id NOT NULL (SQLite allows NULL in a TEXT primary key), 14-day retention on both queues per ADR 0005, deploy secrets in the GitHub Environment argus-cloudflare restricted to main, an account API token with four Edit scopes and 90 days expiry, .worktreeinclude for local-only files. Setup traps found on the way: the test package is now @cloudflare/vitest-plugin, compatibility_date is capped by the test runtime (2026-11-03), wrangler types needs --strict-vars=false. The two D1 databases already existed on the account (created 2026-11-04 18:14Z) and were reused. Explain-back: Arthur described the two D1 databases and the R2 path himself and asked about logs, Queues, Analytics Engine and bindings, which were explained.
stages.verified: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm test (6 passed, 2 files); CI check job green on PR #1; remote sqlite_master: facts has the 8 tables of data-model.md, events has events (event_id NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY; client_time, seq, user_id nullable); both queues at 1209600 s retention (dashboard); environment argus-cloudflare holds both secrets and allows only main. GET /healthz on the deployed Worker is checked against the merge commit right after this commit deploys.

stages.title: Identity, selection and the quiz
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-1-quiz.md, with a review per task, a final whole-branch review and one fix wave. A second review of the PR by five small reviewers, one per area, found six defects, all fixed in the PR: a later completion now removes older answers it no longer carries; parseFlow rejects branch values a step does not offer and steps unreachable from first; decrypt accepts only v1:iv:ct with a 12-byte IV; the email form posts; parseCatalog reports a repeated offer id; the TEST_ROUTES gate is tested on ON, empty and missing. Decisions by Arthur: test routes are on for the deployed demo (TEST_ROUTES is off in wrangler.jsonc and CI deploys with --var TEST_ROUTES:on), and everything user-facing is in English, so the no-offer text is "No offer available". Tooling added in the stage: a Claude Code PostToolUse hook runs oxfmt and oxlint on every edited file, and oxlint now runs the suspicious category and the vitest plugin and fails on warnings. Traps: `pnpm test -t "X"` filters, while `pnpm test -- -t "X"` runs everything; the global Env needs augmenting for typecheck without .dev.vars; secret values cannot be read back from Cloudflare, so .dev.vars.remote is the only copy. Deferred: no body size cap on /api/complete; re-seeding keeps an old partner secret (rotation per ADR 0007 is not built yet); two completions in the same millisecond keep the first; moving the identity middleware.
stages.verified: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm test (138 passed, 13 files); CI check job green on PR #2. GET /healthz, the remote seed, DEMO-2 and partner_secrets_ok are checked against the merge commit right after this commit deploys.

stages.title: Events
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-2-events.md: five tasks, a review per task, a final whole-branch review and one fix wave, then one change by Arthur after the review. Decisions by Arthur: (1) an email inside an event payload: the producer's sanitizePayload() removes every payload key whose name contains email, at any depth, and leaves string values alone; an email inside a string of an unknown type is the accepted risk R-23; (2) the browser outbox drops an unsent event older than one day by its client_time. Rulings during the build: the test plugin reports per-message retries as retryMessages, so the tests follow it instead of the plan's explicitRetries. Defects the reviews found and fixed: a malformed visit_id from the completion body produced Queue messages that could never be stored (now replaced by a Worker UUID); a payload nested about 1000 levels passed the edge, failed json_valid in D1 and sent the whole batch to the dead letter queue (now capped at 32 levels at the edge and in the stored schema); a HEAD request counted as an entry; the outbox waited for the next event to retry (now a 30-second timer); a prelander id outside the id pattern was accepted from the config. Explain-back: Arthur followed one step_answered from the outbox through the Worker checks, the Queue and the consumer into D1, and asked what producer.ts is for; the duplicate and the Queue-down cases were walked through with him. Deferred: a body cap enforced while the body streams, before c.req.text(); a row-by-row fallback when a batch insert fails (the consumer is replaced in stage 5); server events are lost with a log line when the Queue refuses, until the R2 fallback of stage 5.
stages.verified: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm test (217 passed, 20 files); pnpm test -t "TEST-3|ID-1|ID-2|ID-4|BIZ-2|QZ-4|QZ-5|NFR-4|NFR-5|NFR-8|R-12|R-14|R-23" (100 passed); against wrangler dev one visit through completion stored 8 events and no test email in logs or state; Arthur ran the browser flow locally. The same body twice and the 8 events of a browser visit are checked against BASE right after this commit deploys.

DEMO-3, DEMO-4, the repeated Lead and GET /healthz are checked against BASE right after this commit deploys.
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-3-redirect-postbacks.md: five tasks, a review per task, a final whole-branch review and one fix wave. Decisions by Arthur: (1) GET /go?prelander=&visit= carries no offer id; the Worker runs select() for the cookie's user at the press, writes the click, then answers 302, so nothing in the URL can be swapped and a catalog change between showing and pressing applies (R-9); offer_selected with moment redirect is dropped and a visit stays at 9 events; (2) a user with no users row at /go gets a 302 to /p/{prelander} (Q-30); (3) only Arthur can send postbacks to the deployed Worker, because the test partner secrets are in his .dev.vars.remote; reviewers run the demo locally with their own .dev.vars. Correction during the stage: data-model.md said a duplicate postback sends no event; it now follows ADR 0007, so a duplicate sends the event again with the same derived EventID and an event lost to a Queue failure after the D1 write still arrives once. Rulings during the build: every test that changes an offer restores it in finally; every current-design mention of /go/{offer} was updated, earlier stage plans and docs/ai were left as written; the postback event carries payout as the partner's decimal string and occurred_at in ms, while conversions.payout stays REAL; 500 config_error when a partner secret cannot be decrypted. Defects the reviews found and fixed: design.md said 503 happens only when D1 is down (the Queue too, after the row is written); part2-mvp-stages.md said only an accepted postback sends the event; X-Signature had no cap on v1 values (now 8); pnpm postback printed a stack trace when the Worker was unreachable. Explain-back: Arthur first described the Lead return (new visit and click ids) when asked about a redelivered Lead; after the question was restated he named transaction_id as what tells a redelivery from a second Purchase, and said /go selects the offer again at the press. Deferred: a known-answer HMAC vector computed outside the code (before stage 7); the README must say reviewers run postbacks locally (stage 7); catalog_config_error logging at /go and entry (stage 6); stage 4 decides how clicks with user_id null count, and conversions join through clicks; remote atomicity of wrangler d1 execute --file is probed before the first pnpm offer --remote.

stages.title: Report
stages.verified: pnpm check (389 passed, 35 files); pnpm test -t "AN-1|AN-5|AN-7" (TEST-5, 13 passed); pnpm test -t "AN-|R-17|DEMO-5|DEMO-7" (54 passed); pnpm test:e2e against local wrangler dev ends with demo passed against http://localhost:8787; the redirect grep and the MVP-4 BigQuery client grep print nothing. pnpm test:e2e --base on the deployed Worker and GET /healthz are checked right after this commit deploys.
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-4-report.md: five tasks written by Sonnet, a review per task (Opus for the SQL task), a whole-branch review on Opus and one fix wave. First stage without an approval gate (Arthur, 2026-11-05). Decisions in the plan, each from a default in the design: a click whose user was deleted counts as its own user; only the first Lead of a user and offer pair counts, later Leads add only payout (Q-23); M-15 counts a Purchase as without a Lead when no Lead was accepted at or before it; M-2 and M-11 are in the MVP report; report parameters are UTC dates with to inclusive, at most 92 days, 400 invalid_query otherwise; with an offer filter the funnel fields are null; the report is open, sets no cookie and is no-store, so the identity middleware now runs only on /api/events and /api/complete; three indexes for R-17; as_of and events_newest_at are dropped from diff snapshots; the demo script sends three step_viewed events; MVP-4 greps for a BigQuery client or credential, not the word. Also: CI caches the Playwright browsers and bounds the install to 3 minutes, after the install hung for 10 minutes twice on 2026-11-05. Defects the reviews found and fixed: payout totals carried float noise; two never-run statements and wrong metric tags in the AN-8 headers; demo.sh reset the deployed store before checking for .dev.vars.remote, and a failing postback exited without a FAIL line; the docs said a closed postback day never changes, which a user deletion breaks. Deferred: a test that cohort and postback totals agree over a full period; stop_dev_server does not wait for the port (decided by the CI run); drop-offs are not clamped, so a cross-midnight user can make a day's drop-off negative; esc() on the report page has no direct test. Explain-back questions for Arthur, not blocking: why can yesterday's row in the cohort view change today, and which view should finance read? Why does a second Lead for the same user and offer change the payout but not the Lead count? Where does a Lead on a click whose user was deleted go?

stages.title: R2 files and the loader
stages.verified: pnpm check (430 passed, 41 files); pnpm test -t "NFR-3|NFR-4|NFR-5|NFR-8|R-12" (72 passed); pnpm test -t "TEST-3|ID-1|ID-4|BIZ-2|AN-|DEMO-" (101 passed); pnpm test:e2e against local wrangler dev ends with demo passed against http://localhost:8787; pnpm test:browser passed, email scan clean; the paused demo run passed with the funnel cells at 0 and its ok lines matching the normal run; the redirect grep prints nothing; wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle list funnels-events shows loaded-30d on loaded/ and rejected-30d on rejected/, 30 days each. The deployed checks and the loader-paused drill run right after this commit deploys.
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-5-loader.md: five tasks written by Sonnet, a review per task (Opus for the loader task), a whole-branch review on Opus and one fix wave. Decisions in the plan: the consumer writes one NDJSON file per batch to R2 pending/ and acks, retries a failed write after 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 minutes then hourly, and sends the batch to events-dlq after 10 retries; the producer writes a one-event pending/ file when the Queue refuses and answers 503 only when the Queue and R2 both fail; completion and /go keep sending in waitUntil and never answer 503 (stage 2 plan, NFR-4), with data-model.md and metrics-and-operations.md corrected; the loader runs every minute, at most 8 batches of 900 rows (7,200 rows, under D1's 1,000 queries per invocation), writes a manifest before the insert, dedups EventIDs, sends invalid rows to rejected/, inserts with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, writes loaded/ and deletes pending/; a failed insert counts as an attempt only when SELECT 1 answers, five attempts send a batch to rejected/; control/loader-paused pauses the loader (pnpm sink outage on|off [--remote]); GET /__test/health behind TEST_ROUTES; reset leaves R2 alone; the local dev server runs a loader ticker; the demo waits up to 150 s and has a paused mode; R2 lifecycle rules loaded-30d and rejected-30d applied to funnels-events. Defects the reviews found and fixed: R2 state leaked between tests of one file (now clearBucket in beforeEach); no test loaded a producer fallback file into D1; a thrown R2 error ended a loader run without a loader_run line; the NFR-4 and NFR-5 manual steps paused the local loader instead of the deployed one; 51 acceptance commands used pnpm test -- -t, which runs the whole suite; design.md said 503 when D1 or the Queue fails. Deferred: a D1 that answers SELECT 1 but refuses writes sends batches to rejected/ after 5 runs (recoverable for 30 days); overlapping loader runs can reset an attempt count or write already loaded rows to rejected/, which stage 6 notes next to the rejected_new_file alert; an unparsable manifest is skipped silently; open_batches in health is capped at 10,000 without a flag; the paused demo reads the funnel cells once. The deployed checks and the loader-paused drill run right after the merge deploys; their numbers and the ADR 0005 and 0006 Outcome go in a follow-up PR. Explain-back questions for Arthur, not blocking: where does one event wait while the loader is paused, and where while R2 is down? Why does a D1 error count as a load attempt only when SELECT 1 still answers? Why does a run take at most 7,200 rows, when ADR 0006 says 9,000 files?

stages.title: Operations
stages.verified: pnpm check (523 passed, 50 files); pnpm test -t "DEMO-8|R-12|NFR-6|NFR-5|MVP-5|PB-" (196 passed); pnpm test:browser passed with email-scan clean (Task 5); the redirect grep and the src header loop print nothing. The deployed checks (alert_run on Cloudflare, the quarantine drill, the probe, p95 per endpoint, the remote email scan) run right after this commit deploys.
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-6-operations.md: five tasks written by Sonnet, a Sonnet review for Tasks 1 to 4 (Task 5 covered by the final review to save quota), a fix wave for the task reviews, a whole-branch review on Opus, a second fix wave and a scoped re-review. Decisions in the plan: one Analytics Engine data point per request (endpoint index; duration and status; country and colo) and one per loader run (freshness); GET /__probe reads the entry batch for an empty UserID and runs select(), with no rows, no cookie and no events; the alert cron runs every 5 minutes beside the loader's minute cron and writes one JSON log line per firing alert, with thresholds from nfr.md in ALERT_THRESHOLDS; freshness_lag fires only when pending/ files or a readable Queue backlog wait; rejected_new_file fires on any new file, with the note that overlapping loader runs can write already loaded rows there; dlq_not_empty reads Queue.metrics() on an EVENTS_DLQ producer binding; postback_counts (facts migration 0003) counts requests and accepted postbacks per minute and partner, and postbacks_without_conversions fires at 5 requests and 0 accepted in 15 minutes; selection_p95, worker_5xx_rate and d1_overload_errors read the Analytics Engine SQL API with AE_SQL_TOKEN and CF_ACCOUNT_ID, logging alert_source_unavailable without them; GET /__test/files and a remote mode of pnpm test:email-scan scan a wrangler tail log, R2 files and the events table; catalog_config_error logging stays out of the stage (decision 21). Defects the reviews found and fixed: a failing freshness read lost the loader run's data point; a failed rejected/ or quarantine read moved the window on, so that window was never checked; the SQL API fetch had no timeout; the remote scan raced the loader's deletes and passed on an empty tail log; an unreadable Queue backlog would have fired freshness_lag all night; an R2 error on the alert state read as no state; a row committed during the alert run could be skipped; the email test did not scan response bodies. Deferred: one failing SQL query hides all three SQL alerts; the remote scan's health wait names the wrong cause when TEST_ROUTES is off; size alerts fire only on the daily size read; HEAD /healthz is labelled other. The deployed checks (alert_run, the quarantine drill, the probe, p95 per endpoint) run right after the merge deploys. Explain-back questions for Arthur, not blocking: which alert would you see first if the loader stopped, and which if a partner's secret were wrong? Why does freshness_lag stay quiet on the idle demo at night? Why does the alert state keep one window start per source?

stages.notes: Built from docs/plans/part2-stage-7-readme.md: the README written by Opus, the two test additions by Sonnet, the README reviewed by Opus against the stage text and read cold by Fable as the company's reviewer would, one fix round and a scoped re-review. The README opens with what the system does, then the implemented, simulated and design-only split and what to read first, then the architecture in the code; this order follows the cold read, not the stage text's order. It says plainly that the deployed demo's postback steps (DEMO-3, DEMO-5, DEMO-6) need a partner secret only the author holds, so reviewers run them locally, and that the /__test/* routes are open on the deployed demo by choice. The browser test now checks the /go?prelander=demo link and that the browser never requests /go (DEMO-9). tests/unit/signature.test.ts carries a known-answer HMAC vector computed with openssl, checked again by the controller. Defects the reviews found and fixed: the dead letter queue redrive sketch acked messages whose send back failed, and left a pull consumer attached whose retry limit deletes messages (now curl -sf, a jq success check before the ack, and a trap that removes the consumer on every exit); secret rotation was described as not built, while accepting the previous secret is built and tested. Stage 6 deployed checks, recorded here (ruling R4): the email absent from a wrangler tail capture and from the remote scan (clean, tail 7,176 lines, 3 R2 files, 14 events rows); alert_run with unavailable [] on Cloudflare, so the SQL API and Queue.metrics() work; the quarantine drill fired quarantine_new_row 330 s after the postback (the first try missed the row because the new alert cron started about 10 minutes after the deploy and its 5-minute look-back began after the row); /__probe 200 in 0.106 to 0.141 s; p95 from one demo run in the NFR-6 card; AN-5 on BASE moved yesterday's cohort Purchase and today's postback Purchase by one each. Fresh clone from GitHub, following only the README: pnpm install, .dev.vars, migrate, seed, pnpm check (524 passed), pnpm dev with {"sha":"dev"}, pnpm test:e2e demo passed against http://localhost:8787. Open: the spend line is [spend] until Arthur reads the billing page; Arthur reads the README whole before the hand-in; publishing a demo partner secret for the deployed Worker is Arthur's call. Deferred: catalog_config_error logging at /go and entry (known limitation in the README). BASE=$BASE pnpm test:browser runs right after this commit deploys. Explain-back for Arthur, not blocking: run the demo from the README and say what each command proves.

stages.verified: k6 run -e BASE=$BASE -e RUN=$RUN --summary-export $TMP/peak.json load/peak.js; wrangler d1 execute events --remote counts; Analytics Engine SQL p95 query; k6 /__probe at 10/s; pnpm check
stages.notes: Load test at the spec peak against the deployed Worker (main 16d26e9), k6 v2.3.0 from the author's laptop in Poland, WAW colo. 59,990 requests at 199.9/s, all 202, 0 failed, 0 429, 11 dropped iterations; 59,990 rows stored for 1,000 users, total grew by exactly 59,990; drained 241 s after k6 stopped; Analytics Engine counted 59,990, 0 5xx, 0 d1_overload. Server p95 of POST /api/events 74 ms (p50 61 ms) against the 50 ms target: not met. Cause: the Queue send, median about 60 ms per Cloudflare's Queues post; the body read and the send were not timed apart. Facts read via GET /__probe, 601 requests at 10/s: p95 31 ms. Arthur kept the 50 ms target and asked for the actual figure, the cause and the link (R-24, nfr.md "Measured in Part 2 stage 9"). Deviations: the run went from the stage branch before the merge (no Worker code in the stage); stage 9 ran before stage 8, which waits for Arthur's example picks. Deferred: 2x and 5x runs (P-7); a read for a user with rows and the write endpoints under load; other regions; deleting the 59,990 load-test rows from the events table (Arthur's call).
